### Powerpoint - July 3, 2012: How You Can Lead Others to Do Great Things
Author: Dr. Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-july-3-2012.html
Passage: 1 Peter 5:1-3
Points:
- Christian leadership requires active, hands-on involvement rather than mere observation from the sidelines.
- Genuine biblical leaders do not simply issue commands or rally others without participating themselves.
- Believers must step directly into the trenches to serve alongside the people they lead.
